content.title: Content
content.description: Chunk text, for display and citations.

embedding_text.title: Embedding text
embedding_text.description: header_path, a blank line, then content. Embed this field for better retrieval.

header_path.title: Header path
header_path.description: Section path, e.g. 'Guide > Install > Windows'; empty above the first header.

chunk_id.title: Chunk ID
chunk_id.description: Stable 16-character ID scoped to the source; use it as the vector-store upsert key.

chunk_index.title: Chunk index
chunk_index.description: 0-based position of the chunk in the document.

chunk_total.title: Chunk total
chunk_total.description: Number of chunks produced from the document.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source URL or kvs://KEY; null for pasted text.

document_hash.title: Document hash
document_hash.description: Fingerprint of the converted document; changes when the document changes.

token_count.title: Token count
token_count.description: Exact token count of content with the selected tokenizer (cl100k_base by default).

overview.title: Chunks
overview.description: One RAG-ready chunk per item, in document order.
